Make A Payment Frequently Asked Questions Answers to common questions about Desert Dentistry, our services, and what to expect as a patient in Ahwatukee, Phoenix. Where is Desert Dentistry located? Desert Dentistry is located at 4609 E. Chandler Blvd, Phoenix, AZ 85048, in the Ahwatukee neighborhood of Phoenix, Arizona. What are the hours at Desert Dentistry? We are open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, with evening appointments available by appointment. Early morning and late afternoon availability is also offered. Does Desert Dentistry offer same-day appointments? Yes, we offer same-day weekday appointments and convenient evening hours for our patients. Is Desert Dentistry an Invisalign Platinum Provider? Yes, Desert Dentistry are Invisalign Platinum Providers and members of the American Academy of Clear Aligners. We offer complimentary Invisalign consultations and iTero scans. What financing options does Desert Dentistry offer? We accept CareCredit and Sunbit for flexible financing, and offer an In-House Dental Savings Plan for patients without insurance. We also accept many dental insurance plans. Does Desert Dentistry offer sedation dentistry? Yes, we offer nitrous oxide, oral sedation, and IV sedation to help patients stay comfortable and calm during treatment. What is CURODONT and is Desert Dentistry a CURODONT practice? CURODONT is an advanced non-invasive therapy that remineralizes enamel and stops early decay before a filling is ever needed. Desert Dentistry is a proud CURODONT practice. What dental technology does Desert Dentistry use? We use IV sedation, Fotona Lightwalker Laser, iTero wellness scans, AI-assisted digital radiographs, CBCT 3D imaging, Wave One Root Canal technology, digital scanners, intraoral cameras, and ultrasonic scalers. Schedule Your Appointment Call (480) 706-4600 Severely Damaged or Weakened Teeth When a tooth is cracked, heavily decayed, or has undergone a root canal, a simple filling isn't enough to restore its strength. Lifelike, Protective Crowns A custom dental crown acts as a protective 'cap' that covers the entire visible portion of the tooth, restoring its shape, size, strength, and appearance. Benefits of Our Approach Save a severely damaged tooth from extraction Restore full chewing ability Protect a tooth after a root canal Enhance the appearance of a discolored tooth Durable and long-lasting restoration Your Treatment Journey We've designed a streamlined, comfortable process to ensure you get the best possible results with minimal stress. 1 Tooth Preparation We gently remove decay and shape the tooth to accommodate the crown. 2 Digital Impressions We take highly accurate digital scans of your teeth—no messy putty. 3 Temporary Crown A temporary crown is placed while your custom crown is crafted. 4 Final Placement The permanent crown is expertly bonded into place for a perfect fit. Is this right for you? Patients with cracked, broken, or severely decayed teeth, or those who have recently had a root canal. Advanced Technology We use digital impression scanners to ensure your crown fits with absolute precision and comfort. Tooth-Colored Fillings Phoenix | Composite Dental Fillings | Desert Dentistry About Services Preventative Dentistry Cosmetic & Restorative Invisalign Minimally Invasive Veneers Emergency Dentistry Convenience & Technology Invisalign Reviews Financing Events (480) 706-4600 Book Appointment Book Tooth-Colored Fillings in Phoenix Invisible Repair for Cavities Restore decayed teeth with durable, tooth-colored composite fillings that blend perfectly with your natural enamel. Schedule Your Appointment Call (480) 706-4600 Cavities and Unsightly Metal Fillings Tooth decay requires immediate treatment to prevent further damage, but traditional silver amalgam fillings are highly visible and can weaken the tooth over time. Aesthetic Composite Resin Fillings We use advanced composite resin materials that bond directly to the tooth structure, providing a strong, discreet repair that looks completely natural. Benefits of Our Approach Matches your natural tooth color Requires less removal of healthy tooth structure Bonds directly to the tooth for added strength Contains no mercury or metals Prevents further decay and sensitivity Your Treatment Journey We've designed a streamlined, comfortable process to ensure you get the best possible results with minimal stress. 1 Decay Removal We gently remove the decayed portion of the tooth while keeping you comfortable. 2 Tooth Preparation The area is thoroughly cleaned and prepared for the filling material. 3 Composite Placement The tooth-colored resin is applied in layers and shaped to match the tooth. 4 Curing and Polishing A special light hardens the resin, and it is polished to a natural shine. Is this right for you? Anyone with a new cavity, minor tooth damage, or who wants to replace old, failing silver fillings with a more aesthetic option. Advanced Technology We use advanced curing lights and high-quality composite resins to ensure a fast, durable, and beautiful result. Luxury care meets advanced smile design. Schedule Your Appointment Call (480) 706-4600 Tired of Hiding Your Smile? Crooked, crowded, or gapped teeth can impact your confidence and overall oral health. Traditional metal braces are often uncomfortable, highly visible, and require frequent, painful adjustments. The Clear, Comfortable Path to a Perfect Smile Invisalign offers a nearly invisible, comfortable, and removable alternative to traditional braces. At Desert Dentistry, we use advanced 3D scanning to map out your custom treatment plan, ensuring precise, predictable, and beautiful results without the hassle of metal wires. Benefits of Our Approach Nearly invisible clear aligners Removable for easy eating and brushing No painful metal wires or brackets Fewer dental visits required Custom-mapped using advanced 3D imaging Faster treatment times for many patients Improved overall gum and tooth health Your Treatment Journey We've designed a streamlined, comfortable process to ensure you get the best possible results with minimal stress. 1 Initial Consultation We evaluate your smile, discuss your goals, and determine if Invisalign is the perfect fit for you. 2 3D Digital Scanning Using state-of-the-art scanners, we create a precise 3D model of your teeth—no messy putty required. 3 Custom Aligner Creation Your series of custom, clear aligners are fabricated to gently and gradually shift your teeth. 4 Your Smile Transformation Wear your aligners daily, changing them as directed, and watch your new smile emerge. Is this right for you? Invisalign is ideal for adults and teens looking to correct mild to moderate crowding, spacing, overbites, underbites, or crossbites without the appearance of traditional braces. It is perfect for professionals who want a discreet orthodontic solution. Advanced Technology We utilize iTero® 3D digital scanning technology to capture highly accurate impressions of your teeth in minutes. This allows us to show you a virtual preview of your new smile before you even begin treatment.
